messages.subject: Project Lyra - SSA v3 (compromise on caps)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear David, Rachel,

Attached is our further mark-up. As foreshadowed, we've moved the Founder cap to 2.5x and the basket to £175,000, and we've accepted your 30-month survival and the portfolio carve-out. We think that lands the warranty package. If you're agreed, the next versions are clean execution copies.

Best,
James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
www.whitfieldcarter.com
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
